Exact current gravity fields and clamp.

facts.rationale: Preserves the verified movement flow while correcting stale common-attribute field names.
facts.value: Resolves the supplied HSD_GObj to Fighter and Samus ftSs_DatAttrs. ftCommon_FallBasic reads co_attrs.gravity and co_attrs.terminal_velocity, subtracts gravity from self_vel.y and clamps downward speed. Samus attribute x30 is passed to ftCommon_ApplyFrictionAir, which writes a horizontal correction to x74_anim_vel.x based on self_vel.x.

facts.rationale: Restores exceptional common-state branches omitted by the baseline and preserves the collision return-domain ambiguity.
facts.value: Calls ft_80081D0C and invokes no local transition when its result is zero. A nonzero result forwards the object to ft_80082B1C: self_vel.y above ftCo_800D0EC8 selects ft_8008A2BC, otherwise basic landing. For Samus, common completion normally enters Wait but checks DownSpot and hammer conditions first; basic landing also substitutes HammerLanding when applicable. The collision helper returns GroundOrAir, so its numeric guard must not be normalized into a physical floor-contact claim without further evidence.

evidence.why: Different field guards the firing effect.

facts.rationale: Retains supported teardown behavior without assigning an unverified effect-latch identity to x2244.
facts.value: Performs unconditional cleanup by calling efLib_DestroyAll for the supplied fighter object and resetting Samus field u.ss.x2244 to zero. The effect library removes owner-matched managed effects immediately. The specific producer and semantic role of x2244 are not established by this helper; it is distinct from the x2219_b0 guard used by the observed Missile firing-effect helper.

facts.rationale: Replaces ambiguous ground/air transfer wording with exact exit behavior.
facts.value: Provides separate ordinary and smash-input grounded/aerial callback suites. All four IASA callbacks are empty. Animation exhaustion calls common action completion on the ground and Fall in the air. Ground collision enters Fall on a false result from ft_800827A0 for ordinary input or ft_80082708 for smash input. Both aerial collision callbacks call ft_80082B1C on a truthy ft_80081D0C result, reaching velocity-dependent common completion or basic landing with their exceptional branches. These collision paths terminate the move-specific state rather than continue its animation in the paired ground/air side-special state.
